title: Intense High-Speed Chase Ends With Unexpected Surrender
description:
► PDS DEBT is offering free debt analysis to our listeners just for completing the quick and easy debt assessment at http://www.pdsdebt.com/blue

In August 2023, a Fond du Lac County deputy observed a driver with an expired registration and a revoked license due to a prior OWI. The driver attempted to evade the deputy, reaching speeds over 100 mph, ultimately surrendering after a sideswipe incident. Deputies found 33 grams of marijuana in his vehicle, and a records check showed an open case for operating while revoked.
